system.description: You harbor a secret that would bring you great embarrassment or hardship if exposed, and the Storyteller will work to see that it could come out in play. If it does, you may buy off the Flaw immediately by taking a Negative Trait (Untrustworthy is a good choice) or by losing a Status Trait, depending on the circumstances.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
